name: PSXGPT Serve first-turn narrative retrieval v1

source.selection: First user run per session, excluding owner, local, and Codex accounts
source.freshness_check: Stored history contains only the current user message and an empty assistant placeholder
source.privacy: No user, session, message, or trace identifiers are retained

purpose: Test whether Ledger routes and surfaces answer-bearing PDF pages for real, fresh narrative research questions.

judgment_policy.route: Exact entity scope, sufficient authoritative corpora, and separate evidence facets where the request has distinct evidence needs.
judgment_policy.retrieval: Judge the actual Markdown of the first three pages. A page is answer-bearing only when it directly contributes evidence required by the query; a topic mention is not enough.

answer_requirements: recent company events or result announcements
